name: QR_Rule_08: Suspicious or Obfuscated PowerShell Execution
description: Detects encoded, hidden, profile-bypassing, download, or in-memory PowerShell execution patterns.
gpo_policy: PowerShell Script Block and Module logging must be enabled; unauthorized PowerShell use should be restricted.
expression: SELECT username, "Image", "CommandLine", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4104','4103','1','4688') AND (UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%-enc%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%-encodedcommand%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%-nop%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%bypass%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%hidden%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%downloadstring%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%invoke-expression%' OR UTF8(payload) ILIKE '%iex%') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: PowerShell operational or process-creation event contains an encoded-command, bypass, hidden-window, DownloadString, Invoke-Expression, or IEX indicator. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by Username.
